title: 4.13 When is your birthday?
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Ask when a birthday is and say a date with a month and an ordinal number (When is your birthday? It's on March fifth.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.13 Months: January to June: A1 names the months and says My birthday is in July.; A1+ 4.13 asks When is your birthday? and gives the day with on + a month + an ordinal number (It's on March fifth.), bringing back 2.6–2.7's second, fourth, fifth and tenth and 3.11's Luis's. The cast's birthdays are fixed from here on: Ana March fifth, Luis June second, Sofia October tenth, Diego August fourth. A date cannot be photographed: each photo shows one cast member alone at their own birthday cake (A1 4.14's photo of Ana and three new Flash photos), a picture bank changes only whose birthday it is, and Listen sets the dates against each other.
prerequisite: A1 4.13-4.14 months and birthday; A1+ 2.6-2.7 second to tenth; A1+ 3.11 's; A1+ 3.12 Whose.
speaking_outcome: Say the date as month + ordinal (MARCH FIFTH); fifth ends in th after f, and When is links (WEN-iz). Do not require native-like speed.
